'''Gamemodes''' ---- ''For event modes, see [[Events]].'' '''Gamemodes''' are modes which can be chosen at the start of the match, chosen while starting a [[Matchmaking]] match or are automatically chosen upon entering a map in specific [[Elevators]]. These affect multiple parts of the match, which includes enemies that spawn, wave amount, wave bonus or rewards. Some modes can be played in most maps, some only have a limited selection on maps while some modes can only be played in special maps. Most modes require the players to survive until the end of the match. There is an exceptions, that being [[PVP]], where players are tasked with defeating the other team through enemy summons. {{Header|Survival}} {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto;" !
